record.hypothesis: Mechanism. Prepare a valid H.264 derivative that disables deblocking for an entire admitted picture/slice region only when the original filter provably cannot alter any affected sample. Begin with conservative structural conditions on all luma/chroma edge thresholds and quantizer information; do not infer safety from visual smoothness. Keep coded prediction and residual meaning unchanged while rebuilding affected headers, alignment, escaping, lengths, and offsets. First scope. Progressive eight-bit 4:2:0, CAVLC, one slice per picture, controlled quantizers and offsets, ordinary I/P prediction. First prove all affected thresholds make filtering an identity. Do not generalize one low quantizer value to uninspected blocks or chroma edges.
